formulas.what: A hero's largest blow (maxHit): floor(0.35 x (weapon skill + worn +skill) + 0.6 x summed damage bonus + 2), then x the weakness factor, then x (1 + damage buff). Never under 1
formulas.note: playerCombatRolls takes the monster's defence cut off the largest blow (defenceReduction). hurt takes the same cut off every amount that lands on a monster. The register's text names only the second

formulas.what: A hero's chance to land a basic blow: ratio(20 + skill + worn accuracy, the monster's evasion) x 1.15 on a weak-weapon match, held to 5%..97%. Steady then turns a share of the misses into hits
One basic blow: miss is 0, a hit is a whole number 1..maxHit with equal odds (mean (maxHit + 1) / 2)

reads.why: a crit is rolled on the same blow by rollCrit, called beside rollAttack in src/core/hunt/damage.js

formulas.what: Critical basic blows: chance = clamp(gear critB + crit buff + set bonus + Keen, 0, 0.60). A crit is max(damage + 1, floor(damage x 1.5)). The set bonus is 1% a tier for 5+ armor pieces of one tier and line

reads.why: a set bonus counts worn armor pieces of one tier and line, read off the item rows

formulas.what: The damage factor against one monster: weapon weakness 1.20 x bane (at most 1.40) x weapon element (at most 1.15), the product held to 1.90. A weapon match also gives x1.15 accuracy

reads.why: the weapon's type and its element arrive on the equipment stats
bane is a special attribute on worn gear

formulas.note: weaknessInfo also carries the monster's dropBonus out as dropMult, so a drop's chance passes through the weakness reader

formulas.what: Every amount that lands on a unit, in this order. On a monster: x element (a weakness at the tag's weakPm share) then minus the defence cut, x the cast's power (version, store, surge, mark), x the boss guard, x the dealer's stance, x the target's stance, at least 1, x Tempering. On a hero: x power, x stances, then the armor chain. Then the spell shell, then HP

reads.why: the amount arrives as the argument: the caller rolled it
the amount arrives as the argument: the caller rolled it
the amount arrives as the argument: the caller rolled it

formulas.what: A monster's defence: floor(def x 0.03) whole points off every blow and every tick it takes
What an element is worth on a monster: 1000 - 10 x its profile's percent, the percent held to ELEMENT_PCT. A row with weakPm lands only that share of a weakness
A target that takes more: Hunter's Mark (unit fields markPm until markUntil) plus the strongest marking status (takenPm), added and folded into the cast's power
formulas.note: the status reader (src/core/hunt/status-effects.js effectPm) sums the takenPm of every stacking key on a unit

formulas.what: Stance: Offensive deals and takes x1.10, Defensive deals x0.90 and takes x0.85

The steady cut: worn steadyPm (a cape) and a food's steady lower what reaches the hero, last, never past the cap. The part of a point is a chance (the old Tempering rungs that shared it retired with lane/tp-im-steps)
A damaging cast: each hit rolls a whole number from max(ceil(top / 2), base lo) to max(top, base hi), top = floor(maxHit x hitPm / 1000). Then C-HURT. It never misses and never crits
A heal: floor(max(floor(maxHit x healPm / 1000), base) x power / 1000), whole (no roll), x Tempering, less the heal cut, capped at missing HP. Mend alone: floor(maxHp x 110 / 1000) x power

reads.why: the cast's power is the argument pm
the heal cut is taken where the heal lands

formulas.what: A shell: floor(max(floor(maxHit x shieldPm / 1000), base) x power / 1000), a pool that a blow spends before HP. A recast of a self shell refunds the unused part as mana. A party shell never lowers a bigger one

reads.why: the cast's power is the argument pm

writes.why: a recast of a self shell refunds the unused part as mana

formulas.what: A cast's power in permille: the rune tier's step (1000 / 1100 / 1200 / 1300 / 1400 at each tier's skill gate, runes.js versionLevel) x the store's share for a store rune x Surge when it surges

reads.why: Surge is a jewel perk, read off the unit as surgePm

formulas.what: Statuses, one generic engine: a ticking one (Bleed: scale = max(tier share, floor(maxHit x 33 x tier share / 1000)), tick = round(roll 1..3 x scale / 1000) a stack a second, 5 stacks, 6 s), a marking one (takenPm), a slowing one (Chill: clock x (1000 + slowPm) / 1000, 30% to 50% by rune tier), a heal-cutting one (Withered)

writes.why: a marking status is a row with takenPm, landed by applyStatus
a heal-cutting status is a row with healCutPm, landed by applyStatus
a slowing status is a row with slowPm, landed by applyStatus

formulas.what: Every heal a Withered unit takes: n - floor(n x cut / 1000). A hero 30% (less by its necrotic resistance), a monster 50%

reads.why: read through the status reader, src/core/hunt/status-effects.js effectPm
a hero's necrotic resistance shortens the cut, read where Withered lands

formulas.what: Life leech: floor(HP a hit took x leechPm / 1000) back to the caster (Reave 300). Mana back: min(mana spent, hits x manaPerHit + kills x manaPerKill). Focus: a kill returns focusPm of max mana

reads.why: the HP a hit took arrives as the argument

formulas.what: Attack speed: every basic attack is 2,000 ms for heroes and monsters with no speed modifier. A cast locks its lane (offense 2 s, support 2 s, heal 1 s) and its own cooldown. Chill stretches a swing and a windup

writes.why: lanes and cooldowns are rows of src/data/abilities.js ABILITIES and ABILITY_LANES

formulas.what: Mana: regenerates 25% of max a minute x the Inner Flame rate. A caster's basic costs 1 mana. A cast costs its version's mana, never more with level

writes.why: a cast's mana is its row's in src/data/abilities.js ABILITIES, spent in fire

formulas.what: HP regeneration: 0.3% of max a second in a fight and 6% out of one, x the Inner Flame rate 1 + P / (P + 50). The fist wraps add selfHealPm a second
A monster's largest blow: floor(atk x the art tier's scale), scale 5.4 for tiers 1-2, 4.0 for 3-4, 3.0 for 5, 2.2 for 6. It rolls 1..that like a hero's

reads.why: the tier's dial multiplies atk before this is called (src/data/hunt-tiers.js atTier)

formulas.what: A monster's chance to land: ratio(aim, 20 + Defense + worn +Defense + guard), held to 5%..97%. Guard is the defB of gear outside the armor weights (a shield, a cape)

the same `def`: guardB, the guard of gear outside the armor weights
the tier's dial multiplies aim before this is called

formulas.what: What armor does to a landed blow, in fixed order: dodge (medium) = floor(650 x P / (P + 0.4 x L)), absorb (heavy) = floor(750 x P / (P + 0.62 x L)), the resistance, ward (light) = floor(P x 1.5) flat, Tempering, and never more than 60% in all. L is the ATTACKER's Level, with the tier's dial on it

reads.why: the tier's dial raises the Level armor reads
the resistance is one step of the chain, passed in as the element's permille

formulas.what: A hero's resistance: taken = 1000 - min(cap, summed worn resistPm), cap 40% an element and 10% physical. Storm also burns mana for half the HP it took. Necrotic lands Withered

reads.why: resistPm is an attribute a worn piece carries

writes.why: a Necrotic hit lands Withered

formulas.what: A monster row from its Level, role, ground floor and fit: HP = (4.95 + 1.76 x L) x role x fit, blow = a share (13.2% to 22%) of a same-Level hero's base HP, aim and evasion from the reference hero (lands 70%, is landed on 85%), def = 0.08 x L x role

reads.why: a blow is a share of a same-Level hero's base HP (STAT_FORMULA.refHp reads VITALS)

formulas.what: The reference hero a monster is written against: a measured career (the lone hammer) [Level, skill, Defense, worn accuracy] every 5 Levels to 100, sparser to 1,000, straight past it. aimFor and evasionFor invert the ratio

reads.why: the career table was measured on a played lone hammer
the same career wore the weapon line of its day

formulas.what: Normal, Dangerous, Deadly: a pull size and three dials. dmgPm multiplies atk, aim AND the monster's Level as armor reads it. hpPm its HP. xpPm its kill XP. On a gentle ground the tier first takes back the ground's kindness, so its dmgPm is solved per floor

writes.why: atTier reads the dial's dmgPm by name (pmOf): the dial is the Danger scale step's, danger.js dangerDial
atTier reads the dial's hpPm by name, the same
atTier reads the dial's xpPm by name, the same

formulas.what: A monster's spell: it rolls from half to all of floor(its largest blow x hitPm / 1000), then the hero's armor as any blow. A worn shield takes 30% off a marked spell. A mend puts the same roll back on a packmate. The first cast waits a random share of the cooldown

reads.why: the largest blow arrives as the argument

formulas.what: A boss's two lines on his HP: adds arrive at addsPm and he takes only guardPm of every blow while one stands. Under enragePm his atk and aim are x enrageAtkPm, and one named spell's cooldown is x cdPm

writes.why: his adds are spawned when the line is crossed (spawnAdds)

formulas.what: A boss room: one fight, a time limit, his kill ends it, nothing resets. A called room pays nothing. A keyed hall pays as a ground. A boss is the formula's boss role: HP x5, blow x1.1 held to 33% of the FLOOR hero's HP

A Burning Tower floor or a Catacomb room F: 5 monsters, each the stat formula at Level F on a floor-F ground, a Keeper (boss role) every 10th. Past floor 100 every blow is x1.012 a floor, compounding. Floor 300 is the last row

writes.why: a floor is the stat formula at the floor's Level
x (1 + powerStep) to the floor's depth and the room's share
the same

formulas.what: Aggro is rules, not threat numbers: a pack turns on the pull's leader. Challenge takes every monster within 6 tiles that is not on a tank and holds it 8 s. A Healer's basic draws a free monster 18% of the time. A shooter aims at the hero farthest back. A tank under 90% of the strongest tank's HP never takes a turn

Area and extra targets: a shape (the 3x3, a line of len, a ring of r) hits every engaged monster it covers for the FULL roll each, up to maxHits. Follow-through repeats a basic blow on one neighbour. An area arrow hits its footprint

reads.why: a shape hits every engaged monster it covers, so more standing is more hit

formulas.note: effect is the one resolver of a cast, so it is also a home of the hit, the heal, the shell, the mark, the leech and the cast's power. Area and extra targets are the part it decides itself

formulas.what: A pack lives in its room plus a margin (1 tile unless the ground says more). If the aggro holder leaves, the pack resets and heals. A called or keyed boss never resets
formulas.note: a pack that resets heals to full
